paite: Huan ginna hat lou mi, angaihdante gense lou in ngai un.
heading: Khristian Noplenna Zatdan Dik
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

paite: Mi khat in thil bangkim ne thei ding in akigingta a, mihat lou in bel anteh-louhing kia ane hi.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

paite: Ane mite'n nelou a kidekte simmoh kei henla; nelou a kidekte'n leng anete soisel tuan kei hen; Pathian in amah akipahpih khinta ngal a.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

paite: Midang sikha tung a soiselpa nang kua na hia? Apu a ding in ahi adin hiam ahihkeileh apuk. Himahleh amah zaw dinsak in a-om ding, Toupa'n adingsak thei hi.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

paite: Mi khat in ni khat nidang sang in athupi ngaih tuam a, midang in ni tengteng kibang chiat in angai. Michih amah lungsim ah kitheichian hen aw.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

paite: Ni tangpa'n Toupa pahtawina ding in atang hi. Huan bangkim nepa'n, Pathian kiang a kipahthu agen ziak in, Toupa pahtawina ding in ane a; aneloupa'n leng Toupa pahtawina ding in ane kei a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen hi.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

paite: Kuamah eimah a dia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah a dia si leng i hi sam kei.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

paite: I hinleh Toupa a ding in i hing a; i sih in leng Toupa a dia si i hi ngal a; huaiziak in i hin in leng, i sih in leng Toupa a i hi uhi.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

paite: Khrist sihna leh ahin nawnna pen, mihing leh misi Toupa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

paite: Himahleh nang bang achia na unau soisel na hia oi? Ahihkeileh nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian' thukhenna tutphah ma a dingh vek ding lah i hi ngal ua.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

paite: "Toupa'n, kei ka hin bang in, mi tengteng ka ma ah akun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiang ah akipulak ding uh chi in ka chiam ahi," achi, chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’” Isaiah 45:23

paite: Huchi in i vek un Pathian kiang ah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uhi.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

paite: Huaiziak in kisoisel nawn kei ni, kuapeuh in a-unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum zaw hen.
heading: Kitundingtuahna / (Gal 6.1-2)
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

paite: Amah mawngmawng a siang lou bangmah himhim a-om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah hi; thil khatpeuh siang lou a seh pen bel aseppa a ding in siang lou ahi mai hi.
english: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

paite: Na banghiam nek ziak a na unau lungsim anatleh itna dan in na gamta kei' a ahi. Asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa na thil nek in hihmang kei hen.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

paite: Huchi in nou a dia hoihna, gilou lam a gen in om kei hen.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

paite: Pathian lalgam nek-le-dawn thu hilou in Kha Siangthou a diktatna, kituahna leh kipahna ahi zaw hi.
english: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu ah Khrist nasem Pathian kipahpih leh mihing phat in a-om hi.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

paite: Huchi in kituahna ding leh kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
english: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

paite: Na thil nek ziak in Pathian nasep hihse ke'n. Thil tengteng asiangthou ngei a, himahleh banghiam anek in mi ahihpukleh anepa a ding in gilou ahi.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

paite: Na unau pukna ding ahihleh, sa neklouhte, uain dawnlouhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh ahoih ahi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

paite: Ginna na neih Pathian ma ah nangmah kia theih in nei mai in. Ama hoihsak lam a siam louh kitan lou tuh mihampha ahi.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

paite: Himahleh ginglelpa'n anekleh, ginna a anek louh ziak in, siam louh atang hi; bangpeuh ginna lou a hih zaw khelhna ahi.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
